mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MISSION WHERE mission_status = 0

SELECT A.MISSION_SEQ as missionSeq, A.MEMBER_SEQ as memberSeq, B.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, A.MISSION_CATEGORY as missionCategory, A.MISSION_TITLE as missionTitle, A.MISSION_CONTENT as missionContent, A.MISSION_GENDER as missionGender, A.HELPER_SEQ as helperSeq, A.MISSION_RESERVATION as missionReservation, A.MISSION_RESERVATION_DT as missionReservationDt, A.MISSION_TIME as missionTime, A.MISSION_COST as missionCost, A.MISSION_STATUS as missionStatus FROM MISSION A, MEMBER B WHERE A.member_seq = B.member_seq AND mission_status = 0 ORDER BY MISSION_SEQ DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT A.MISSION_SEQ AS missionSeq, A.MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, A.MISSION_CATEGORY AS missionCategory, A.MISSION_TITLE AS missionTitle, A.MISSION_CONTENT AS missionContent, A.MISSION_GENDER AS missionGender, A.HELPER_SEQ AS helperSeq, A.MISSION_RESERVATION AS missionReservation, A.MISSION_RESERVATION_DT AS missionReservationDt, A.MISSION_TIME AS missionTime, A.MISSION_COST AS missionCost, A.MISSION_STATUS AS missionStatus, R.RATING AS rating, L.wayPostcode, L.wayAddress1, L.wayAddress2, L.endPostcode, L.endAddress1, L.endAddress2, IMG.image_name AS imageFileName, IMG.image_etx AS imageFileEtx FROM MISSION A JOIN MEMBER B ON A.MEMBER_SEQ = B.MEMBER_SEQ JOIN ( SELECT MISSION_SEQ, MAX(CASE WHEN LOCATION_TYPE='WAY' THEN POSTCODE END) AS wayPostcode, MAX(CASE WHEN LOCATION_TYPE='WAY' THEN ADDRESS1 END) AS wayAddress1, MAX(CASE WHEN LOCATION_TYPE='WAY' THEN ADDRESS2 END) AS wayAddress2, MAX(CASE WHEN LOCATION_TYPE='END' THEN POSTCODE END) AS endPostcode, MAX(CASE WHEN LOCATION_TYPE='END' THEN ADDRESS1 END) AS endAddress1, MAX(CASE WHEN LOCATION_TYPE='END' THEN ADDRESS2 END) AS endAddress2 FROM MISSION_LOCATION GROUP BY MISSION_SEQ ) L ON L.MISSION_SEQ = A.MISSION_SEQ LEFT JOIN MISSION_IMAGE IMG ON A.MISSION_SEQ = IMG.MISSION_SEQ LEFT JOIN MISSION_RATING R ON A.MISSION_SEQ = R.MISSION_SEQ WHERE A.MISSION_SEQ = #{missionSeq}
SELECT -- IMAGE_FILE AS imageFile, IMAGE_NAME AS imageFileName, IMAGE_ETX AS imageFileEtx FROM MISSION_IMAGE WHERE MISSION_SEQ = #{missionSeq}
SELECT member_seq AS memberSeq, helper_seq AS helperSeq, mission_status AS missionStatus FROM mission WHERE mission_seq = #{missionSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MISSION ( member_seq, mission_category, mission_title, mission_content, mission_gender, helper_seq, mission_reservation, mission_reservation_dt, mission_time, mission_cost, mission_status ) VALUES ( #{memberSeq}, #{missionCategory}, #{missionTitle}, #{missionContent}, #{missionGender}, #{helperSeq}, #{missionReservation}, #{missionReservationDt}, #{missionTime}, #{missionCost}, 0 /* 신청(대기)는 0 */ )

INSERT INTO mission_location (mission_seq, location_type, postcode, address1, address2, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{missionSeq}, 'WAY', #{wayPostcode}, #{wayAddress1}, #{wayAddress2}, #{wayLatitude}, #{wayLongitude})

INSERT INTO mission_location (mission_seq, location_type, postcode, address1, address2, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{missionSeq}, 'END', #{endPostcode}, #{endAddress1}, #{endAddress2}, #{endLatitude}, #{endLongitude})
INSERT INTO mission_image ( mission_seq, image_name, image_etx, image_file, create_dt ) VALUES ( #{missionSeq}, #{missionImageFileName}, #{missionImageFileEtx}, #{missionImageFile}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE MISSION SET member_seq = #{memberSeq}, mission_category = #{missionCategory}, mission_title = #{missionTitle}, mission_content = #{missionContent}, mission_gender = #{missionGender}, helper_seq = #{helperSeq}, mission_reservation = #{missionReservation}, mission_reservation_dt = #{missionReservationDt}, mission_time = #{missionTime}, mission_cost = #{missionCost}, mission_status = #{missionStatus} WHERE mission_seq = #{missionSeq}

UPDATE mission_location SET postcode = #{wayPostcode}, address1 = #{wayAddress1}, address2 = #{wayAddress2}, latitude = #{wayLatitude}, longitude = #{wayLongitude} WHERE location_type = 'WAY' AND mission_seq = #{missionSeq}

UPDATE mission_location SET postcode = #{endPostcode}, address1 = #{endAddress1}, address2 = #{endAddress2}, latitude = #{endLatitude}, longitude = #{endLongitude} WHERE location_type = 'END' AND mission_seq = #{missionSeq}
UPDATE mission_image SET image_name = #{missionImageFileName}, image_etx = #{missionImageFileEtx}, image_file = #{missionImageFile}, create_dt = NOW() WHERE mission_seq = #{missionSeq}
UPDATE mission SET mission_status = 9 WHERE mission_status = 0 AND mission_seq = #{missionSeq}
